bullets: Built a multi-stage speech-to-text and LLM pipeline (gpt-4o-transcribe, GPT-4o) that converts clinical consultations into structured documentation, raising clinical checklist coverage from 26% to 60% and cutting critical "must-not" errors to zero.
Re-engineered an LLM document-generation pipeline (gpt-oss-120b via Groq), raising real clinical test cases passing from 5/8 to 8/8 and reaching 10/10 on every accuracy check across repeated runs.
Cut reasoning tokens by 55% and replaced a second LLM call with deterministic code, keeping every request within strict rate limits, with automatic retry and clear error handling.

Implemented a fully local PII de-identification stage (OpenMed) so patient-identifiable data never reaches an external LLM; now working on multimodal extraction to structured JSON (Llama vision) and embedding-based retrieval with Amazon Bedrock.

projects.name: Ledger Pro - multi-client accounting SaaS (production)
projects.summary: A lower-cost alternative to Xero and QuickBooks that lets accountants manage the books of multiple organisations from a single dashboard.
bullets: Built React + TypeScript frontend features and developed billing and invoice management end to end on Django REST APIs and PostgreSQL.
Worked on-site with the first paying customer, turning their live feedback into UI changes so workflows matched the Xero experience they were moving from.
Integrated SendGrid and Twilio for inbound and outbound email: transactional notifications and processing of incoming customer email.
Took part in code reviews, testing and Docker-based deployments in an agile team.

projects.name: Product discovery - ride-hailing app with an integrated digital wallet
bullets: Interviewed three-wheel drivers and riders in Kilinochchi, Batticaloa and other districts to find out why PickMe and Uber still struggle to reach rural markets, and delivered a findings report to leadership.

Assessed the regulatory path under the Central Bank of Sri Lanka's Payment Cards and Mobile Payment Systems Regulations No. 1 of 2013: a licensed finance company (Rs. 2.5 billion minimum core capital), a non-bank operator licence (Rs. 150 million unimpaired capital), or a bank partnership holding all customer funds in a custodian account.

Mapped CBSL wallet limits (Rs. 150,000 enhanced-KYC, Rs. 20,000 basic) against ride-payment use cases; the analysis informed leadership's decision to pause development until a viable banking partnership was in place.

Built an end-to-end NLP and ML pipeline on ~100K multilingual tweets (English, Tamil, Sinhala) to predict virality, combining TF-IDF text representations with tweet content features, tweet metadata and user metadata.

Raised recall from ~30% to ~70% while keeping precision around 90%, handling class imbalance with model-level class weighting (class_weight="balanced" in Random Forest, scale_pos_weight in XGBoost) rather than resampling; Random Forest and XGBoost performed best.
Benchmarked Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting and XGBoost with TF-IDF, Word2Vec, FastText and VADER features, with experiments tracked in MLflow and data versioned with DVC.
Built data collection pipelines with Scrapy and Selenium, and ran hashtag network analysis with NetworkX and Neo4j.
